_comment: T.A.R. model registry. Tiers are chosen from AVAILABLE ram (not total), because the rice + browser already eat most of it. 'safe' = stock instruct tunes, 'open' = abliterated/uncensored tunes that don't refuse on security/tooling code. Sizes are on-disk GB of the model layer.

tiny.desc: Potato / heavy multitasking. Fast but dumb.

light.desc: Laptop with the full rice running. Good chat, weak reasoning.

mid.desc: Roomy laptop / light desktop. Solid general assistant.

heavy.desc: Gaming rig. Real code review, actually follows instructions.

tasks._comment: Task-aware routing. The RAM tier sets the CEILING and the task sets the PREFERENCE inside it: the first model in `prefer` that is already pulled AND fits the budget wins. num_ctx is deliberately NOT varied per task -- changing it forces ollama to reload the model, and an oversized KV cache on a CPU-only box is the single biggest cause of slow replies.

code.desc: Writing, reading or debugging code, configs, shell, QML.

vision.desc: Anything with an image attached (camera frame, screenshot).

quick.desc: One-liners, yes/no, a fact, a command name. Latency beats depth.

chat.desc: Default. General conversation and system questions.

model_sizes._comment: Size lookup for models that only appear in tasks.prefer, so the budget check works without them being a tier or an extra.

extras._comment: Hand-pickable alternates, not auto-selected. Use: tar_brain.py set-model <model>

dolphin3:8b.desc: Dolphin 3.0 on Llama 3.1 8B. Very compliant, chatty.

dolphin-mistral:7b.desc: Classic uncensored Mistral. Older but light.

hermes3:8b.desc: Hermes 3, steerable and light on refusals.

qwen2.5-coder:3b.desc: Already on this box. Code-focused but refuses sometimes.

speed._comment: Adaptive speed governor. tar_brain records first-token latency per (model, num_ctx) in perf.json and demotes itself when it busts the budget: first by halving num_ctx, then by dropping to the next faster model in `ladder`. Set config `speed` to fast|auto|quality.
